sloka: वनम् गते धर्म परे रामे रमयताम् वरे ।कौसल्या रुदती स्वार्ता भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-६१-१॥
transliteration: vanam gate dharma pare rāme ramayatām vare ।kausalyā rudatī svārtā bhartāram idam abravīt ॥2-61-1॥

translations.english: When Rama, the greatest among those who please the people, he who was conscious of his duty left for the forest. Kausalya, sobbing in bitter anguish, said to her husband:
